visualCharacteristics: Grid of promo content cards; each whole card is a link with an image on top, title, body text and an arrow label.
contentPattern: One row per card: image | h3 title, body paragraph, link paragraph (link text is the arrow label, its href is the card link). Section heading and trailing CTA are default content in the section.
usage: Small grid (typically two) of promotional teaser cards.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for static grids of linked promo cards. Use carousel when cards should scroll.
